svg.text: The Consecration and the elevations · LM-096A–LM-103C · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

g.text: The servers ascend and kneel beside the priest
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar · eyes host · holding-host
AC1: kneeling-erect · predella-epistle · faces altar · eyes altar · L on-breast / R holding-bell
AC2: kneeling-erect · predella-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
host @ Held between the thumb and index finger of both of the priest's hands, just above the
front-centre fold of the corporal. [horizontal] — by priest
pall @ Lying flat on the mouth of the chalice. [horizontal]
bell @ Carried up from the lowest step and held in AC1's right hand on the predella, Epistle
UNRESOLVED: Whether the servers make any reverence as they leave the lowest step and ascend to
the predella is not fixed by the approved record.
UNRESOLVED: The resting position of AC1's free left hand between the bell rings is not fixed by
the approved record; it is depicted at his breast.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-ROLE-01, INV-BELL-01,
The words of Consecration over the Host
priest: standing · bow head-moderate · predella-centre · faces altar · eyes host · holding-host
AC1: kneeling-erect · predella-epistle · faces altar · eyes altar · L on-breast / R holding-bell
AC2: kneeling-erect · predella-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
host @ Held between the thumb and index finger of both of the priest's hands, just above the
front-centre fold of the corporal, while his elbows rest on the mensa. [horizontal] — by priest
pall @ Lying flat on the mouth of the chalice. [horizontal]
bell @ In AC1's right hand on the predella, Epistle side. [upright] — by AC1
UNRESOLVED: The approved record says only that the priest's head is inclined over the Host; the
graded depth of that inclination is not fixed, and it is encoded here as head-moderate.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-ROLE-01, INV-BELL-01,

it, shown to the people. [horizontal] — by priest

The chalice uncovered, taken and blessed

pall @ Set aside on the mensa toward the Epistle side of the corporal while the chalice stands

UNRESOLVED: The place on the altar at which the pall rests between the uncovering of the chalice
and its replacement is not fixed by the approved record.
UNRESOLVED: Whether fragments need wiping over the corporal is conditional in the approved
record: "if needed wipe fragments over corporal".

The words of Consecration over the chalice
“Hic est enim Calix Sanguinis mei, novi et aeterni testamenti: mysterium
fidei: qui pro vobis et pro multis effundetur in remissionem peccatorum.”
